title: Hosted API feature gate and contract negotiation for chat + toolchains
creator: Asha Mehta
description:
Background: Enterprise customers increasingly request combinations of chat streaming, function/tool calling, and strict structured outputs (JSON/typed responses). These multi-action requests have higher operational risk (latency, failure modes, data routing) and often require contractual commitments (capacity, SLAs, logging/audit).

Problem: Our current intake process treats these as single features and routes them to general hosted API triage. This leads to inconsistent eligibility decisions, unpredictable customer expectations, and operational surprises in Dedicated/Private onboarding. We need a deterministic feature gate and a short 'contract negotiation' workflow to align eligibility, SLA, and rollout path before engineering work is scheduled.

Goal: Define and implement a lightweight product gate + contract-negotiation checklist for hosted multi-action feature requests that: (1) classifies requests into operational tiers; (2) produces a clear decision: self-serve allowed / hosted pilot / dedicated/private required; (3) surfaces required SRE/infra commitments and legal/compliance flags; (4) generates a one-page customer contract stub and onboarding checklist for Solutions/Sales to use.

Scope: This ticket covers PM decisioning rules, intake form updates, decision matrix, and the initial SLA/commitment templates. Implementation handoff to ENG and Legal is out of scope but required downstream artifacts are specified here.

Out-of-scope: Deep implementation of telemetry or runtime quotas (ENG), enterprise contract negotiation (Legal) beyond template stubs.
acceptance_criteria: A decision matrix that maps request signals (streaming=true, tool_calls>0, structured_output=true, tenant_size) to one of: self-serve, hosted-pilot (SLA caveats), dedicated/private evaluation.
Updated intake form fields that capture required signals (max concurrent streams, expected tokens/sec, tool-call count, data residency / compliance needs, retention requirements).
A one-page contract stub template and onboarding checklist for hosted-pilot that lists minimal infra commitments, monitoring dashboards to provision, and rollback/fallback policies.
A short escalation flow for requests that hit "high operational risk" (customer_impact=high) pointing to SRE, Sales Engineering, and Legal contacts.
Stakeholder sign-off recorded from SRE, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Design on the decision matrix and intake form changes.
rollout_notes: Phase 1: Publish decision matrix and intake form update in Confluence; run 2-week pilot with Solutions team on incoming enterprise leads. Phase 2: Collect pilot signals and refine thresholds (tokens/sec, tool-call frequency). Phase 3: Hand off templates and matrix to ENG/Infra + Legal with clear required inputs for Dedicated evaluation. Communicate change via internal Monday standup, Solutions playbook update, and a short training session.
linked_artifacts: Google Sheet: Intake field telemetry expectations (estimation worksheet)
